proposal.hypothesis: One row per SIMD group with float4 loads, eight cached float4 values per lane, and simd_sum avoids threadgroup barriers and a second input pass, reducing latency versus threadgroup reductions.

Halving total threads to 4096 while caching the 1024 weights once per 128-thread group and reusing them for two rows per SIMD group reduces weight traffic and scheduling work without extra input passes.
